description: How often and how deep each brand discounts, over a window (7-365 days, default 30), from two separate readings: homepage_banner = days a promotion banner was on the brand's homepage (read from our homepage captures; 'not_measured' when we hold no capture in the window), and product_markdowns = products whose price, read in the window, is below their full price, with average and max markdown %, in one store and currency per brand. A brand can run product markdowns with no homepage banner.

domains.description: Brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["gymshark.com"]. Omit for all your tracked brands.
